changelog: Cine Music 2.0: Floating PIP cancel & dismiss button, dedicated 5-tab Cine Music navigation (Home, Playlist, Downloads, History, Profile), clean category explorer without count clutter, Playlist with Play All queueing, interactive All Albums soundtrack sheet, full listen history management with delete/clear, high-speed 320kbps offline song downloads via 3-dot menu with storage tracking and space reclaim.
